scope: Offline retrospective normal-only objective comparison; no attacks, exploitation or traffic replay
design: Three goals x three information modes x two datasets x three seeds = 54 fits on complete existing matrices

goals.permutation: Original within-batch independent endpoint permutations, balanced normal/synthetic-negative binary cross entropy. No added negatives in history.
goals.next: Predict current operation method/service/resource categories from strictly preceding requests and, when allowed, non-operation current metadata. Current target fields are always zeroed. Three categorical cross entropies; no attack class.
goals.masked: Reconstruct hidden feature blocks: method, service, resource, wire/timing/counts. Four fixed full-block masks, equal mean squared error. Endpoint identities are never reconstruction targets. No attack class.

backbone: Same initialized input projection 48, GRU 48, output heads for all cells. Inactive branches/heads retained; primary contrasts are within this common backbone, not a reproduction of original TGN.
training: Normal training only, 12 epochs, batch 512, AdamW lr .001 weight decay .0001, clip 5, seeds 11/29/47, two CPU threads. Base features only, original train-only normalization and vocabulary unchanged.
primary_test: Granomaly SMF known-endpoint stratum: 706 positive requests, all eligible known-endpoint normals. Score full streams first, stratify metrics afterwards without altering history.
thresholds: Freeze calibration-only upper empirical quantiles for .001 and .01 before testing. Same thresholds apply to full and known strata. No test-optimized polarity or seed/model selection.
report: AP, recall, actual FPR, TP/FP, clean-holdout FPR, 512-request 200-replicate conditional block intervals; clean false alarms per observed capture hour. Three seeds are not independent deployments.
legitimate_new_instance_capture: Unavailable. Three normal NRF requests with unknown endpoints lack independent evidence of legitimate instance replacement; not treated as an independent deployment or a verified lifecycle scenario.
limitations: Already inspected datasets and known SMF strata: adaptive retrospective research
No new real-world collection or proof of malicious impact
Common GRU/MLP backbone isolates goals but does not establish superiority over published TGN architecture
Time-normalized alarms describe trace duration, not production operation
All normal-label unknown-participant diagnostics retain original unverified labels
